purpose: Audit whether the butterfly host-resource results have broad taxonomic and geographic replication suitable for a GEB-scale generality claim, without changing the existing primary analyses.

taxonomic_replication.rule: All represented butterfly families are retained; no family is selected or excluded based on effect direction.

geographic_replication.crosswalk_source: Official tdwg/wgsrpd level3 GeoJSON at the pinned commit
geographic_replication.rule: Every WGSRPD3 unit used by the resource reconstruction is mapped to its Level 1 region. No Level 1 region is selected after seeing the result.
regional_metrics: log1p contemporary minus log1p native resource units

directional_replication_checks.aggregate_expansion: No directional success rule; regional estimates are reported descriptively because the existing full-panel association is near zero.

interpretation_rule: Informative thresholds label where a directional replication estimate is interpretable; they never remove regions or families from the reported audit table.
